designThesis: Northline sells make-slots through a real saddlery bench order ticket: closed ticket face holds product, price band, materials and 3-week lead; open gatefold centers the Field Tote plate and hide-grade choice ending in Request make-slot — refuse lifestyle luxury heroes and fake social proof.
subjectGrounding: Northline Leather Goods; audience people who buy small-batch bags and straps and care about hide grade; products Field Tote, Belt No. 2, Shoulder Strap; materials bridle leather, solid brass, vegetable tan; price band DKK 890–2.400; make-slot lead time 3 weeks; brand ink brown / warm cream / single brass accent; plain trade English; assets product plates Field Tote + Belt No. 2 (have), no lifestyle models; anti purple SaaS gradient, handshake photos, fake 4.9★.
composition: First viewport staged as narrative gatefold liner notes: closed ticket face owns the fold; open spreads hide chips and secondary goods around the central Field Tote product plate; Request make-slot sticky on mobile.
informationHierarchy: 1) Closed ticket facts (product, price band, materials, 3-week lead) 2) Open: Field Tote plate 3) Hide grade choice 4) Request make-slot 5) Secondary goods as ticket lines (Belt No. 2, Shoulder Strap).
typography: Condensed industrial display for product names (trade catalog, not luxury italic serif); humanist sans with tabular figures for prices, stitch counts when known, and lead time; sentence-case trade English labels; avoid Inter/DM Sans/Playfair/Fraunces/cream-serif-terracotta default cluster.
colourAndMaterialModel: Restrained: ink-brown desk ground, warm cream ticket stock panels, single solid-brass accent on active field rules and primary CTA; light surface under cool north workshop light; no purple SaaS gradient, no neon, no black-and-gold boutique foil.
imageryAndAssetStrategy: Load-bearing product plates only (field-tote.webp, belt-no-2.webp); deliberately no lifestyle models; stitch-macro needed/not had — omit or mark placeholder, do not invent; Shoulder Strap plate unknown — text/silhouette fallback marked synthetic if required; no stock handshakes.
interactionConcept: Open ticket inks product + hide onto the ticket face; hide-grade selection updates grade stamp and lead line; motion intensity 2 — one short settle ≤200ms, instant under prefers-reduced-motion; request is a real form stating 3-week lead.
signatureElement: northline-bench-ticket — order ticket [data-signature="northline-bench-ticket"] that fills as configuration completes
primaryRisk: Gatefold can read as novelty if closed face lacks trade facts; closed face must show product, price band, materials, and 3-week lead before open. Missing stitch-macro and Shoulder Strap plate must not be faked.
implementationGuidance: Mobile-first HTML/CSS. Semantic request form. Use only declared have-plates. Hide as radio/segmented control. Prices and lead time only from evidence. AA contrast on ink/cream; brass UI ≥3:1. No ebru/oscilloscope/starship grammar unless alternate chosen. Forbidden: purple SaaS gradient, handshake stock, fake stars, testimonials, free worldwide shipping, lifestyle models. Seed key screening-v2-01-leather-goods-impeccable; assigned grounded candidate 3 Saddlery bench ticket; poolRevision 94ff10ff20de; composition gatefold-liner-notes.
unknowns: Exact hide grade nomenclature; exact stitch counts per product; Shoulder Strap plate asset; stitch-macro.webp; live make-slot inventory beyond stated 3-week lead; any reviews/celebrities/shipping claims (must not invent).
